Who we are

One family, three destinations.

Majidi Mall is one of the largest shopping and entertainment centres in Iraq. Since opening its doors on 23 November 2009, it has offered residents and tourists alike an incredible shopping, dining and entertainment experience — all under one roof.

Visitors shop in an air-conditioned, hygienic and safe environment that combines natural daylight with the spaciousness of open-air streets — an architectural design that pushes new boundaries in what a shopping centre can be.
